Is it worth paying someone to do social media for my real estate business?

The SocialDMNov 11, 2026
Short answer

For most Realtors and title reps, yes, if it keeps you posting consistently and makes you look like the local expert. Consistency is what keeps you top of mind when someone is ready to buy, sell or refer.

Why agents do it themselves and stall

  • Posting stops the moment you get busy with clients, which is exactly when you need it most.
  • Template posts look like everyone else's, so they are easy to forget.
  • Content is all listings and "just sold," with nothing about the neighborhoods you know.
  • Your Google Business Profile sits untouched, so you are hard to find in local search.
  • Hiring an agency built for big brokerages costs more than a solo agent needs.

What it costs you: a past client who forgets your name refers someone else. Staying visible every week is cheaper than winning that client back.

How LocalLift Signature helps: LocalLift Signature is a done for you posting service for Realtors and title reps.
